title: UCKK Dimension Gateway Component Contract
description: Defines the controlled boundary for user-selected or explicitly authorized media transfer into a declared UCKK dimension. The gateway verifies the selection, source authority, target dimension, content identity, applicable admission rules, and transfer integrity; stages the media in quarantine; submits the accepted representation to UCKK Platform through a registered contract; and produces an admission receipt. It does not own the source media, the final UCKK object, publication, or external AI processing.

canonical_responsibility.primary: Control explicit dimension-targeted admission of selected media into UCKK without bypassing UCKK Platform authority.

authority_boundaries.source_authority_before_acceptance: The source actor or source component retains authority over the selected media until UCKK Platform accepts the submitted representation.
authority_boundaries.final_authority_after_acceptance: UCKK Platform owns the admitted UCKK object and all resulting UCKK state.
authority_boundaries.gateway_authority: The gateway owns only the admission session, quarantine state, validation results, transfer coordination state, and admission receipt.

provided_interfaces.name: create_admission_session
provided_interfaces.purpose: Create a bounded admission session for one explicit source selection and one declared target dimension.

provided_interfaces.name: submit_selected_media
provided_interfaces.purpose: Transfer the explicitly selected media or registered source artifact into gateway quarantine for verification.

provided_interfaces.name: validate_admission
provided_interfaces.purpose: Run all registered source, dimension, integrity, format, policy, and profile admission checks without creating final UCKK state.

provided_interfaces.name: commit_admission
provided_interfaces.purpose: Submit the validated representation to UCKK Platform and complete only after UCKK Platform atomically accepts or rejects the admission.

provided_interfaces.name: cancel_admission
provided_interfaces.purpose: Cancel an uncommitted admission and schedule quarantine cleanup.

provided_interfaces.name: get_admission_status
provided_interfaces.purpose: Return the current admission state and non-sensitive diagnostics.

provided_interfaces.name: get_admission_receipt
provided_interfaces.purpose: Return the admission receipt by admission or receipt identity.

provided_interfaces.name: health_and_readiness
provided_interfaces.purpose: Report process health, quarantine readiness, target-dimension resolution, UCKK Platform connectivity, and receipt readiness.

consumed_interfaces.interface_purpose: Resolve target dimensions and atomically accept or reject the final admitted representation.
Verify user, component, artifact, signer, and source assertions when required by the active profile and source contract.
Evaluate governed admission, consent, disclosure, privilege, or exception decisions when selected by the active profile.
Admit and schedule bounded hashing, validation, quarantine-copy, and cleanup work within the active resource envelope.
Submit selected admission and security evidence when required.
No runtime dependency. The reference exists solely to enforce separate publication and admission contracts.

admission_validation_response.pass_semantics: The staged representation satisfies all currently applicable admission checks but has not yet become an authoritative UCKK object.

result_semantics.accepted: UCKK Platform atomically accepted the representation and returned the authoritative UCKK object reference.
result_semantics.rejected: UCKK Platform or active admission policy resolved the request and did not accept it.
result_semantics.blocked: Required authority, integrity, compatibility, resource, policy, or evidence could not be verified.

published_events.name: admission_session_created
published_events.meaning: A bounded admission session was created.

published_events.name: admission_session_create_failed
published_events.meaning: The request could not establish a valid admission session.

published_events.name: selected_media_staged
published_events.meaning: The selected media was fully staged and content identity verified.

published_events.name: selected_media_transfer_failed
published_events.meaning: The selected media could not be staged as declared.

published_events.name: admission_validation_failed
published_events.meaning: One or more admission checks failed or were blocked.

published_events.name: admission_accepted
published_events.meaning: UCKK Platform atomically accepted the representation.

published_events.name: admission_rejected
published_events.meaning: The admission was authoritatively rejected without final object creation.

published_events.name: admission_blocked
published_events.meaning: The admission could not proceed because required authority or control was unavailable.

published_events.name: admission_cleanup_completed
published_events.meaning: Gateway quarantine state was removed according to retention policy.

published_events.name: uckk_dimension_gateway_degraded
published_events.meaning: One or more admission capabilities are unavailable.

published_events.name: uckk_dimension_gateway_recovered
published_events.meaning: Required admission dependencies and checks recovered.

failure_contract.condition: Admission request is incomplete, malformed, or inconsistent.
No valid explicit user or authorized component selection exists.
Requester lacks authority to transfer the selected source.
The declared target dimension does not resolve.
Declared and computed content identity differ.
Transfer terminates before complete verified staging.
The media representation does not satisfy its active contract.
Required policy, consent, privilege, or exception authority is unavailable or negative.
Required bounded hashing, transfer, validation, or cleanup resources are unavailable.
UCKK Platform cannot resolve or accept the admission.
UCKK Platform rejects the final admission.
Required terminal admission receipt cannot be created.
Required selective audit evidence cannot be submitted or retained.
Quarantine content cannot be removed after terminal state.
A publication request is submitted to this gateway.
A request attempts to invoke Suno, Gamma, or external AI through this gateway.
